notes.title: Update 1.0.3.4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/d512ed82cb25ab19645674dbc46bdc366ae6ecb4.jpg"]

Friendly ships no longer damage your team, you can now kick unwanted players from your online session, and a random name generator is now available during character creation. Plus, there are several other improvements and fixes.
Online Improvements
Fixed an issue where ships would get stuck during their destruction animation in online sessions.

Fixed a bug in online sessions that caused a player's ship to lose all its appliances and furniture when edited.

Fixed a bug where certain quest items would be missing if the connecting player and the host were at different stages of a quest.

A kick button has been added to the current session panel for each connected player, allowing the host to remove unwanted players.

The location of each player is now displayed in online sessions.

Fixed a bug that caused some ships to damage their own allies.

Fixed a bug that caused a space station's barrier to disappear for a connecting player in a remote system.

Fixed a bug where users who had left the server would not disappear from the interface for some connected players, causing the list to accumulate over time.

Fixed a bug that caused the map to function incorrectly if a player disconnected while using the system or galaxy map.
Other changes
Fixed a bug that caused the player's ship to teleport to the center of the star system when using the editor at a space station.

Fixed a bug that caused teleportation to be too loud.

Fixed a series of errors that would occur if the player died while the map or ship editor was open.

Liberated pirate outposts now inherit the name of the pirate base and correctly display notifications when entering/exiting the zone.

A "Random name” button has been added to the character customization menu.

When splitting a stack of colored blocks, their customization is now preserved.

Knights who are part of story quests no longer change their appearance when transitioning to another planet.

notes.title: Cubic Odyssey update makes the intergalactic Minecraft rival way more varied
notes.notes:
Have you ever been playing Minecraft and wished you could take your adventure off terra firma and into the stars above? That's the premise of Cubic Odyssey, which launched on Steam in May 2025. Developer Atypical Games is still in the process of expanding what it has to offer, and the latest update overhauls the story-driven adventure mode to make every playthrough feel unique. While it was already easy to draw comparisons to the likes of No Man's Sky, this new change pushes things even further in that direction, in a good way.
Read the rest of the story...

New space sandbox game Cubic Odyssey takes Minecraft to an intergalactic scale

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9f2072a098ac9de53004da4bfd22ac2ae7985806.jpg"]



We’ve improved random-seed generation, added several multiplayer tweaks, fixed a number of pesky bugs, and more. Plus, you can now sell off every ship in your fleet except for one that you choose to keep!
Random seeding fixes
Generation of random seed planets has been further refined to make caves more elaborate and interesting.

An issue where points of interest of the same type could spawn on top of one another during the initial creation of random seed planets has been fixed.
Online improvements
Fixed a multiplayer issue where some appliances became permanently locked and could not be interacted with.

Fixed an issue with item mods not updating correctly when transferred to another player in multiplayer.

Fixed a rare issue where the pilot could spawn outside of their ship when joining an online session.
Other fixes and changes
Players can now sell their ships, leaving only one final chosen ship. This function is available at any ship editor terminal.

Skin tone can now be customized for new characters. We plan to add an item that will allow appearance customization for existing saves as well in the future.

The planet map interface now shows the levels of available ore on that planet.

Fixed an issue related to the “auto step” feature, which blocked movement through some 2-block high arches.

The target dummy has received an updated system for displaying damage dealt and damage per second (DPS).

Structures built from blueprints will now appear on the scanner, as they were previously impossible to find after being placed.

Fixed a crash related to the graphics API on Steam Deck and PS5.

Fixed the disappearance of the UI element that allows for rotating cubes during placement.

Trading resources from nearby chests now works correctly.

Fences and railings have been moved to a separate crafting tab.

Fixed a bug that caused light sources to turn on every time the game was loaded.

Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect outpost name to be displayed when entering or exiting a zone.

Fixed a bug that caused the player's rocket projectiles to collide with each other and explode in mid-air near the ship.

Fixed instances where a sound would get stuck looping in one place during transitions between planets.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.1
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/37ab2a14f65cd5a15e4aa456ffbb0594ac73bb0a.jpg"]

We’ve prepared something special for you! Random galaxy seeds are here! Start a new game in Adventure mode and make the galaxy unique—every planet and star system is shifted to a new location, keeping things fresh even for the most experienced players. This update also brings numerous balance and gameplay tweaks, UI improvements, multiplayer polish and much more.
Adventure mode
 You can start Adventure mode games with random Galaxy seeds, which change the galaxy completely.

Adventure mode will now start players with Tier 1 gear, a ship and a speeder on a random planet.

Only the same game-mode characters can join online sessions now.

Older adventure mode saves which don’t have a ship will be awarded the ship and speeder at the first load.
Online improvements 
Online clients are now spawned flying their ships when joining a session in space.

Online clients will be spawned in their ship if they join a session on a planet.

Improved the multiplayer ship sync logic – they will look smoother now.

Doors and elevators now properly sync over the network.

The server’s warp and portal locations are now completely synced with the clients.

Painting events with the paint gun are now synced across the network.

The Refinery and Recycler now work better over network, no longer duplicating items.

Fixed an issue causing certain locked chests to appear unlocked to some clients.

Fixed an issue causing network grenades to explode twice.

Pirate base enemy count is now displayed for online clients too.

Fixed issues causing the amount of darkness on a planet to be different between server and clients.

One can no longer place cubes on other player’s ships or the ones for sale.
Gameplay and balance changes
A setting to enable “one cube” stepping has been added. This setting can be restricted to “only while sprinting” too, so you won’t have to jump everytime.

Cleansed planet rewards now work properly, one player can receive the bonus each hour.

The outpost establishment and ranged have been refined to a smaller starting area but expanding by placing objects.

Neutral NPCs will react to high damage shots similar to more smaller shots and become defensive.

The players will no longer be allowed to repair speeders they already have in their collection and lose the resources.

Mimic creatures will show their true shape when getting hit – sometimes you killed one and never knew it was there.
Fixes & changes
The health hearts bar will now become a two line bar when you unlock more than 16 temples.

Fixed the missing speeders from the trader list when one had multiple speeders for sale.

Fixed ships going underwater in some situations.

Fixed an issue causing the UI to count small temples as big temples on the planet map.

Fixed UI overlap of a focused ship and creature at the same time.

Fixed an issue where opening a second ship in the editor resulted in incomplete physics, preventing you from making changes.

The repair button has been removed from the Cargo section of the ship editor.

Multiple UI overlap fixes.

Fixed an issue causing some Speeder to be loaded under the textures.

Fixed an issue blocking the hover mode in Creative mode.

Fixed some issues related to player ship deaths which caused ship to become invisible.

Fixed the fire rate bonus indicator (it was showing as multiplied, but it’s just additive).

Planet portals will now place players in a nicer position and orientation.

Numerous crash fixes and other minor performance and stability improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.14
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/f15357c60995f5d043bf3ba93e1e2fe333e61f38.jpg"]

Your spaceship will no longer go into space without you, if your character dies during takeoff! We’ve improved online, fixed a number of bugs, and made block removal in the ship editor much easier.


Online improvements:

Fixed the two death overlap in some scenarios for online clients.

Fixed an issue causing items to get their durability reset when discarding them during online sessions.

Fixed the initial portals list available from a server to its clients.

Travel portal discovery now propagates to everyone in the session.

Respawn positions for online clients will now favor their ships.

Using the ship editor as a client will change the current ship in the online session.

Fixed an issue duplicating the generation of planet content when a client saved a remote online session’s world.

Fixed the link between speeders and their traders not showing up always in online sessions.

Fixes to the way a planet’s current corruption value got synchronized across network.

Fixed a situation when a planet state would not get saved if a client was disconnected from it and the host was in a different area.

Fixed the UI for the recycler for clients not always syncing properly.

Fixed the mining ray of the extractor positioning for clients on the server.

Fixed a set of issues related to client’s speeders: not getting removed when the client left, they are summoning back if another player used them.

Clients will auto-embark their speeders when summoning them in online sessions.

Fixed an issue causing online clients not to receive XP for the piloting skill when destroying pirates in space.

The galaxy map will now display the host’s current warp gates discoveries, not the clients.

Fixed some rare occasions when a client would use a portal to another planet and end up spawned in lava.

The appearance of all quest related NPCs is no longer random for each player.

The host’s starting broken speeder can no longer be repaired and stolen by other players.

Ships and speeders:

\[MAJOR] The Ship editor on the space station now allows for removal of “mass volumes” Just like the multitube placement the “left click” action hold will create a deletion volume which will remove all blocks in that section (assuming the player has space for them in their inventory).

Fixed an issue with pirate ship sounds like they were player controlled and having an invalid volume.

Fixed an issue sending the ship into space and respawning the player on the planet if he died during the take-off sequence.

Quests and achievements:

Fixed an issue causing some NPCs and Quest items to show up doubled in the world.

Fixed some situations when a quest marker for a location on a planet will keep showing on different planets.

Fixed unlocking of missed achievements/trophies by checking on game load and granting any that meet all the requirements.

Other fixes:

A “hover mode” key has been added for the creative mode. It can also be triggered by double-jumping.

Fixed the missing gear stats update for some bonuses (like sprint speed) after a fresh load.

Appliances which will not result in a lootable disassembly have the disassembly effect red.

Fixed the trading menu not having the proper level requirement displayed when only one item was available.

Fixed the rotation action for some objects, which ended up with them inside the voxel supporting them.

Fixed some AI positioning issues for some creature that have ranged attacks.

Fixed an issue causing items duplication when leaving and rejoining a session in fast succession.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.13
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/21edbd97812fe641ef9348b84d3d9d150c1ed63a.jpg"]

Story NPCs no longer throw themselves recklessly into danger! We’ve fixed the “Jack of All Trades” achievement, made a number of graphical improvements, refined the UI, and also fixed several bugs related to online sessions.
Online improvements
Fixed an issue which did not allow clients to purchase or interact with ships for sale in certain conditions.

Joining an online session in space will start with the player controlling his ship.

Loot shared in online session between players will no longer reset its durability.

Fixed a lot of the ship’s incorrect behavior when syncing over network.

The current online session info will be displayed in the pause screen instead of the controls.

The online connection screen looks better now, it has a background.
Graphic and UI improvements
Fixed a graphics issue with the player helmet being drawn during the game pause in first person.

Some UI overlaps have been addressed. Addressed a number of minor UI issues.

The save indicator is now displayed while the ship is being saved too.

Other ships in space are now valid cruise targets, both enemies and other players.
Bug fixes & other improvements
Certain main quest steps have been added safety checks. Quest NPCs are no longer allowed to be underground, for example (Casascutum really liked to go mining under the enemy base).

The “Jack of all trades” achievement has it’s on-load trigger fixed, should pop up for a lot of people when just opening the game if they ever had the 4 classes at least level 10.

Fixed a crash related to the fireflies visual effects.

The continuous fire after respawn was fixed.

The paint gun will no longer paint the ship while it’s being internally processed, and those changes would end up lost. A warning is displayed.

The teleport inside ship and leaving the driving seat positions have been refined to fix moving into the ship’s walls.

Fixed a lot of memory leaks, a handful of them were related to ship editing.

When teleporting trough planet portals, the player will no longer be placed on the highest block in the area.

Fixed some physics issues with the speeders, which did not allow connected players to interact with them in some situations.

Fixed a situation when the last change to a ship edit was lost.

More auto-saves are performed, especially for a server when another player disconnects while on a far away planet.

notes.title: An Update on Dedicated Servers!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9ddb5c8211e8a436f79c14e0b4e80be9f86d4a0b.jpg"]

Back in May we shared with you the roadmap for Cubic Odyssey, where we have planned to release an update with dedicated servers support at the end of July. We have come a long way since that day, working hard on the game, bringing a dozen updates and hotfixes, so you can enjoy your journey through the cubic galaxy both solo and with your friends.

Yet, we’ve planned to launch dedicated servers in July, they will be released a little bit later, as soon as we’re sure they are working just fine for you to embark on a new journey with your friends. Since we’ve already started talking about dedicated servers, we wanted to share some more information that will quench your curiosity.

Dedicated servers will be the best way to experience co-op play in Cubic Odyssey. They support more players than the current P2P servers and do not depend on the host, meaning you can play even when the host is away, as long as the server is live.

You will need to create a new character that will be tied to the server. Your progression and inventory will be saved on the server, so you won’t lose any progress even if the server goes offline.

A wide number of settings will be available for the owner of the server, where they can adjust game mode, password, etc. Once the server is created, its owner can share the session ID with the people they want to invite.

Dedicated servers are absolutely free for everyone who owns the game and will be available via a separate application. For example, on Steam you will be able to find it in the Tools section of your library.

In addition to that highly anticipated feature, we are working on “seeding” of the galaxy, which you will be able to try out on your newly created server as well, keeping the adventure fresh even for those who have already completed the story of Cubic Odyssey.

We hope dedicated servers will bring you a lot of joy and memorable adventures with your friends and, in the end, will be worth the wait.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.12
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9e0eab25648e21c3ff063f453fbd14678f79ede2.jpg"]

We’ve fixed a number of bugs and critical issues in online. Low-tier loot will no longer disappear, blueprints won’t request more materials than needed, and you don’t have to worry about deadlocks during online sessions anymore!

Fixed an issue that caused the game to completely freeze during online sessions.

Fixed an issue making low tier spawned loot disappear as it was spawned.

Fixed an issue causing the blueprint yard to consume extra stacks of material when filling the needed blocks.

Fixed an issue which saved and rewarded all server’s vehicles to the clients.

Fixed the spaceship sliding away from below the player when connected to an online session.

Fixed a controls issue with the speeders and vehicles when pausing the game with controls active.

Removed the interaction indicator for online clients with pirate ships.

Fixed the missing HUD markers of pirate ships for online clients.

Fixed an issue causing the FOW and Markers of a planet to show up for another planet.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.10
notes.notes:
Online sessions are now more stable, and many gameplay mechanics synchronize properly between the host and the client. We also have improved the speeders hovering system, fixed several bugs related to spaceships.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/ac8a85282a6d2059aa22bea8f6e89fe4db6af62c.jpg"]
Online improvements
Fixed looting of space chests as an online client.

Fixed a situation in which a client could not summon its speeder anymore after leaving it on some other planet.

Ship position and orientation sync over network has been improved.

NPC appearance is now properly synced across network.

Derelict and for-sale ships now spawn correctly with their doors and driving seats for online clients.

Some quest steps will complete now for the host when a client performs them.

Fixed an issue which caused locked ship controls when joining an online session from a space station.
Spaceship and vehicle improvements
Fixed more occasions which would reset a ship's design when repairing.

Tweaks to the planet vehicles hovering system.

After unlocking the mobile planet purifier, the final step of purifying can be triggered from the player’s UI.

Fixed an issue causing multiple first broken speeders to spawn on the first planet.

Fixed a situation in which a ship's damage FX would remain in the scene even after the ship would be removed.

Fixed some issues with the range from which a player could teleport back to his ship.

When replacing a ship’s battery, the HUD message now correctly reports the number of remaining batteries.
Bug Fixes & other improvements
Some safeguards have been put in place now to not allow certain actions like repairing or modyfing a ship while it’s been processed by the game engine.

Fixed an issue causing the quest markers for the towers on Quberion to disappear.

Fixed a situation which would have a temple spawn without its decorations.

Fixed the stuck player’s firing of weapons during cutscenes.

Fixed a situation in which space darkness generators would respawn on load.

Planet portals UI will show only properly activated portals now (they used to show all discovered ones, even powered down ones).

The UI and Text scale options are not available on consoles too.

The reward chest from clearing a planet now spawns correctly at the base of the statue.

Multiple crash fixes and other tweaks.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.7
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/5dd8cc36eef700c893f55bf762cfe84b1c1688c4.jpg"]

Pirates no longer carry grenade launchers or spawn near players! We’ve also made several balance changes and added some handy new features, including a chat wheel!
 New features
PC players can now use Shift and Ctrl(default mapping) for quickly transferring 1 item or the full stack of an object in the inventory UI.

A chat wheel has been added (Z key on PC and right shoulder while in the item selection wheel with a controller) to send a set of 10 predefined phrases to the online players.
Online Improvements
Online clients auto save their current state like in offline.

The online weather system is now synced for planets, the host tended to overwrite all the galaxy with his weather.

Fixed the invulnerable pirates spawning only for a joined client.

Fixed online gear colors not getting properly synced sometimes.

Enemy turrets now synchronize properly even when the server is not around them.

Fixed some situations in which a temple portal would not properly activate for online clients.

Locked chests are no longer used for pooled crafting by online clients.

Meteor crash sites now get marked on the HUD for online clients too.

Fixed the NPCs spawning in the floor of the space station for some clients.

Added a quick save button to the pause menu which works in Online Mode too to save the character, inventory and ship status.
Balance changes and gameplay improvements
Spawned pirates no longer have grenade launchers, Your structures are no longer threatened by large-scale destruction. Not just on PC, but across all platforms.

Re-balanced the weapon aiming sway for snipers and removed it completely for the other weapon types.

Elevators can now be mined back, and its behavior has been improved to stop at detected floors.

The radial quick wheel has received some usability improvements.

All players will no longer be automatically teleported after placing a portal on the ground.
Bug fixes 
Fixed the missing health bars of enemies on some occasions .

Fixed an issue causing pirates to spawn very close to the player.

Fixed the incorrect time zone for the save timestamp and wrong screenshots created during the quit to menu save.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.5
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/37f8485ecd160ec6f32587e2d41226fa3096cf28.jpg"]

We’ve improved online session stability, resolved some issues with controls on PC and consoles, and fixed a number of minor bugs.
Improvements
Spawned pirates no longer have grenade launchers, Your structures are no longer threatened by large-scale destruction.

Online servers have their game mode marked with icons.

Crafted items will have mods of their tier if such mods exist for that object.

You can now destroy mods installed on items to free that slot for another mod.

Captured pirated bases become travel points for online clients as well.

Creative mode sessions are now allowed only for creative characters.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the secondary quests the online clients could not turn in for completion.

Fixed some control locking issues happening when the quick slots selector was active.

Fixed the quick wheel not always selecting properly when activated.

Fixed some controller input issues when rotating or moving objects in an online session.

More small bug fixes and crash fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.3
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/dd6fa37dc8897567e68ed0ab659b075b7fa72d85.jpg"]

Now the story progress will be smoother! In this update, we have fixed several bugs that caused some players to lose progress or get stuck on a storyline mission. Additionally, you can look forward to numerous improvements to the online mode and space travel!
Bug Fixes
Fixed the reward of freeing Helioctus not triggering always.

Fixed some situations where the darkness walker would not take damage in the static phase.

Fixed a crash related to transferring ship batteries from secondary cargo tabs.

Fixed items getting damaged more then they should have been when the player died.

Fixed some situations in which the main quest line would get locked with Nexus related tasks after returning from there.

Fixed a crash occurring when returning to a system with mined asteroids.

Fixed the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S save locks blocking the saving of the game altogether.

Added two game launch parameters for Steam: Vulkan and DX12 to force the game to start on that respective graphics API.
Online Improvements
Fixed the removal of the prison holding Helioctus not always happening for a connected client.

Fixed the inability of players to fix some broken ships in space when connected to a session.

Fixed an issue preventing online clients to move and disassemble the appliances they placed.

Fixed an issue locking the quick-wheel radial menu from showing up if a client would get disconnected when it was active.

Fixed some occasions when the client’s state would not get saved when getting disconnected from a server.

Fixed: The appliances on the Mobile Light Strike ship were not visible for online clients.

Joining a session right from the first tutorial screen it will skip the tutorial.

Fixed some situations in which online clients could not repair their first ship.
 Spaceships fixes
Fixed a naming error in the Fighter class ship components.

Normalized ship lasers volume (we had reports they were louder then other sounds).

Fixed some occasions in which a player’s ship would run off in the distance after leaving the driving seat.

Fixed the ship HP getting reset and hindering structure repairs after loading the game.

Ships will no longer take structure damage through their shields.

Completely repaired ships now instead of a Repair button have a Reset one in the ship editor. This button reset the design/appearance of the ship to the default. This is mostly for players who got their damaged ships registered as “designs”.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.2
notes.notes:
We’re continuing to work on various bug fixes and crash issues. In addition, we’ve made pirates weaker to make them easier to deal with!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/744256477f763b44350d7e431d4c0b79deccc45e.jpg"]

Fixed flying creatures passing through the ship and not colliding properly with the world.

Fixed the sometimes missing quest markers for the final 4 dark key holders.

Fixed a bug where colored glass cubes could not be mined, leading to crashes.

Fixed some of the spawning of invincible enemies for online clients.

Pirate’s shield recharge rate and delay have been increased.

Fixed a bug that prevented players from mining resources from an asteroid using the extractor.

notes.title: Co-op Improvements in Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Long-awaited co-op improvements are here! Now you can enjoy Cubic Odyssey with your friends in story mode — repair ships and speeders, close chests from other players and a much more! 

We’ve also fixed some bugs and crashes, and improved the saving system!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9d0b084cf25b8be77a94efa33e583a252673cb7e.jpg"]
Online Improvements
Online sessions have been restored for the Story mode.

Network clients will progress their main quest and retain that progress upon leaving the online session.

Clients can now repair and purchase ships and speeders while connected to an online session.

A lock button has been added to chests to allow or block the access of other players to them.

Fixed the loss of chests placed in the ship while connected to an online session.

Fixed the endless spawn of network explosions occurring in some instances.
Bug Fixes
Tree growth is now properly synchronized over the network.

Fixed a crash from having an open chest during a client multiplayer disconnect.

The character’s weapon projectile interaction with ships has been refined - no more bullets stopping in empty space.

Fixed a bug where the skill progress icon would be drawn in certain UI scale values.

The “Jack of all trades” achievement will now trigger when starting the game, if you have the needed requirement class levels.

Fixed the broken naming of the ship components crafting tabs.

Fixed an issue with traders not properly resetting their stock over in-game time.

Fixed the ship collider boxes being too large and stopping player projectiles.

Fixed a bug where a client would interact with a box and result in the contents being reset.

Fixed the recipe for The Hoarder backpack as it was using more components than allowed.

There will be no visual artifacts associated with landing and passing through the geometry of planets anymore.

Fixed a bug that was removing player hearts when unlocking new temples.
Save Game Improvements
Added delete buttons to save slots to allow cleanup of saves.

Auto saves created by the game are now marked with the “Auto-save” label.

A button to save a remote world from an online session and overwrite your local one has been added.

Changing the color of a ship is now saved in the same way as deleting or adding cubes in the editor.
Basic Mod Support
Mods on PC no longer need to overwrite the original game files — they now create copies in a separate folder.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.32
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/2a84cbc4b7de09209bd9f586f8e09a223df8aab7.jpg"]



While the programmers are fixing the coop, our art team is also not standing aside, but is making new content

 

We’ve added 5 new high-level ships, a variety of additional furniture items, and fixed numerous bugs and crashes.
Improvements and New Features
Added 5 more high-end ships: Argonaut, Vespira, Neutron, Planet Biter, Leviatan.

A lot of furniture.

UI for objects inside of the ship has been improved to allow the extra slots.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an interaction resulting in the duplication of backpacks.

Fixed a situation where the flashlight would become very narrow.

Fixed a crash from joining a multiplayer session just after creating a new character.

Fixed missiles not damaging pirate ships.

Fixed a bug where blueprints stored a damaged ship design, resulting in missing blocks.

Fixed a bug where the character could stand on a flying creature.

Fixed a building with some odd positioned doors as decorum.

Fixed the loss of batteries when crafting them with a full inventory.

Fixed the Gun of Etherion not functioning properly.

Fixed an issue resulting in halved sized hit-boxes for ships.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.28
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/a5490ce32619a3cb47bd9097a064e070f5b4e356.jpg

Pirates no longer attack unmanned ships, the recycler no longer clones batteries, and several crash issues — including those when exiting the game, landing on planets, and some other cases — have been fixed. We’ve added cargo sorting for ship inventories and color customization for ramps, stairs, and railings.

Improvements and New Features

 Added item sorting to ship cargo tabs.
 Pirates no longer attack ships without a pilot, including doors and placed modules. Previously, even empty ships would get damaged, but now these targets are ignored by the AI.
 Ramps, stairs, and railings can now be painted in different colors.

Bug Fixes

 Lowered VRAM usage on Steam Deck — this should fix crashes near pirate bases.
 Fixed a crash that could occur when landing on certain planets.
 Fixed an issue where exiting the game could trigger a false crash report.
 Fixed a bug where transferring one battery to a slot would erase the whole stack.
 Fixed a duplication bug with energy cells in the recycler.
 Fixed an issue that caused the main quest to get blocked at the "Free the Queen" step

Progress and Quests

 You can now abandon quests again in Adventure Mode.
 Fixed a progression blocker that asked players to re-purify Fintan 1.
 Fixed a bug that could block progression if pirate bases were cleared before the relevant quest was active.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.22
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/2af53c09ea5f033050b5ecf3eefddc8ffd495a4a.jpg

We continue fixing issues related to space exploration, resolving crashes, and improving balance and combat systems.
Batteries for gear and ships can now be stacked up to 100 in your inventory!
Pirates have been tamed: they won’t be attacking empty ships and speeders anymore, and destroying their ships no longer causes crashes.

Crash fixes & improvements

 Pirate ship crash finally fixed
 Added Vulkan as graphics API - dedicated to people who see the Fatal Out of Video Memory crash. Make sure to restart the game once the API has been changed
 Fixed a crash related to the damage numbers and some resolution changes
 Fixed a situation where the quest step of reaching the settlement would not trigger
 Restored crafting consoles from the Knight’s requests when missing
 Fixed the current quest marker not showing up in the galactic map for some tasks
 Fixed railing not adjusting properly to some placing layouts

Ships & Space Travel

 Batteries now stack to 100 in the inventory, the gear slots can house only one
 Same goes for ship batteries
 Fixed inaccessible systems like Tartaglione
 Fixed a space crash triggered by odd planets positioning
 Crashed ships will be present on planets of technology level 1 too
 Fixed the situation in which a ship with very low damage could not be repaired and modified
 Fixed a bug which caused ship batteries to disappear from cargo when the ship was going out of energy

Combat & Balancing

 Pirates will no longer attack ships and speeders without a pilot
 Fixed the turrets not fully aiming up or down towards their targets
 Batteries no longer take damage when the player dies
 Removed aggressive events and attack on player from creative mode

Controls

 Fixed the D-Pad selection of quick-slots in the ship editor
 Fixed controller navigation in the ship appliances transfer interface
 Invert pitch setting for character affects the ship editor too now

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.20
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/576d2a7d1b9b7ea47fa182391a56cabe469b734d.jpg

Ship structures now save correctly after repairs, and hidden damage no longer blocks restoration. We’re continuing to refine control settings and address crash-related issues for a smoother gameplay experience.

Ships & Building

 Fixed an issue where ship structure changes were not saved in the shipyard, for example after repairs.
 Resolved a problem where “invisible” ship damage wasn’t being registered — you can now repair and restore your ship as expected.

Controls

 Resetting input settings now correctly applies to controller mappings.
 It’s now possible to assign the same key or button to multiple actions.

Crashes & Stability

 Fixed crashes that could occur when completing pirate bounty quests.
 Fixed a crash caused by rockets hitting crashing pirate ships.

Combat & Balancing

 Shields now absorb all incoming damage, even when depleted in a single hit.
 Tweaked overlapping damage logic to prevent unexpected one-shots from pirate rocket launchers and shotguns.
 Red Darkness Walkers now stay vulnerable for longer, and their defense recovers gradually — giving you more time to retreat safely.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.19
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/6f93c72c2b5870a55b24a1f6b8b1ab4d29f7d78b.jpg

This update focuses on improving game stability and refining controller support. Here’s what has been addressed:

Controls & UI

 Added dead zone settings for left and right controller sticks
 Fixed the “swap left/right joysticks” setting not working
 Improved controller UI navigation — some previously unreachable buttons are now accessible
 Fixed a crash when navigating menus with a controller and quitting to the main menu

Online & Save Stability

 Fixed an issue that caused excessive network message spam, which could lead to lag and desynchronization.
 Resolved a bug that could corrupt your save after leaving an online session

Crashes & Bugs

 Fixed a crash related to the QB-1’s target being destroyed
 Fixed crashes when interacting with the smuggler on a certain space station
 Fixed crashes caused by modded items in the player’s inventory
 Fixed crashes caused by explosions
 Fixed a crash occurring from destroying certain types of pirate ships
 Removed certain platform stats tracking that could cause instability

Thank you for your continued feedback and support.

notes.title: Cubic Odyssey Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/682c55f971a90ebcb3c3edf4a842c54de395dc57.jpg

We are excited to share important news with you: Cubic Odyssey is almost ready and there are only a few finishing touches left, to shape the game into what we want — and maybe exceed your expectations.

The game will be released on May 14th, 2025 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S.

Get ready to embark on this epic space journey with friends or solo. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/78378a98f66233a6d6c74449514eb4613f431b0c.jpg

In Cubic Odyssey, you will explore the galaxy, where every star system and hundreds of planets are unique and hide many mysteries to uncover. Choose one of four classes and fight back the Red Darkness menace, which consumes planets and threatens all life. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/f2261dce91c24cb095442ed8e4e3c87ddb7f7d51.jpg

Build anything you want, from modest houses to huge space battleships. The only limit is your imagination. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/0613c3d9fede26a8d32084529f251cb00315cc30.jpg

While you are waiting, you can add the game to your wishlist and download the demo on the Cubic Odyssey Steam page for free. Enjoy the first couple of hours, where you will be able to try out the Miner class, and explore one planet. Gather resources, craft tools, build a base, and fix your spaceship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/b6d95a60225f5be6911c42fa174fb2cad6357b54.jpg

If you have any questions feel free to ask us anything on our Steam page, X, Facebook, Instagram, Discord or TikTok. Make sure to subscribe – there's a lot of exciting Cubic Odyssey news coming your way soon!

We can’t wait for you to share this wonderful adventure with us.
